questions.qtext:
In this question, the given statement is followed by some conclusions. Choose the correct option that follows the conclusions.

Statement:
Senior Managers warned the workers on the shop floor that because of Korean Car makers introducing new models in car industry, there is a threat to the workers. They also said there will be reduction in sale of cars to general public. The interest rate on cars will see an upward trend with reduction in sale of cars.

Conclusion C1: Korean workers are taking over jobs of workers in Indian industry.
Conclusion C2: Korean investments are coming to an end in car industry.

options.text: C1 follows from the statement but C2 does not.
C2 follows from the statement but C1 does not.
Both C1 and C2 follows from the statement.
Neither C1 nor C2 follows from the statement.

questions.solution:
The statement only mentions a threat due to Korean car makers introducing new models and reduced car sales; but does not imply that Korean workers are going to take over the jobs in India – leading to conclusion that C1 DOES NOT follow.
The statement implies that there is likely to be MORE investments by KOREAN Companies in car industry – meaning that C2 also DOES NOT follow. Hence option ‘d’ is correct.

questions.solution: Since there is NO correlation between fruits and flowers, C1 DOESNOT follow which means option ‘a’, ‘c’ and ‘d’ CANNOT be true leaving ONLY option ‘b’ as the valid option which can be verified by making a simple venn diagram.

questions.qtext:
In a multiple choice question paper having 30 questions, the marking scheme is as under:
+5 marks for each correct question;
+1 mark for each unanswered question;
No score for wrong response.
A group of 4 students named Arun, Bishal, Chetan and Dhawal gave the following statements:
Arun: My score is 141
Bishal: I have scored 144
Chetan: My score is 147
Dhawal: I scored 139.
Only one of the students has got a valid score. What is the name of that student?
questions.solution:
If Chetan has scored 147, it means he has done 29 questions correctly i.e. 29 × 5 = 145 but the 30th question can give him 0 or 1 leading to possible score of 145 or 146.

Bishal has scored 144 implies that he could have done 28 questions correctly leading to a score of 28 × 5 = 140 but remaining 2 questions can possibly give score of 2 or 1 or 0 depending on his incorrect attempts. This leads to possible scores of 140 or 141 or 142 leading to possibility of option ‘a’ being correct option.

Dhawal having scored 139 means that he has attempted 27 questions correctly leading to a score of 27 × 5 = 135 but remaining 3 questions can possibly give maximum score of 3 i.e. total possible score = 138.

questions.qtext:
A sum of Rs.100 kept in deposit under compound interest doubles itself in 6 years. If the maturity
amount received now is put in deposit on the same terms, then after 42 years from the start, the
amount deposited now becomes Rs.________ .

Numerical answer type
questions.solution:
Let the original sum of money be Rs.100. After 6 years, this amount will become Rs.200.
Please note that the money is doubling itself every 6 years. When we say 42 years from start, it
means 42 – 6 = 36 years from the first maturity. 36 years is equivalent to 36/6 = 6 sets of 6 years each. The deposit amount will multiply itself 2*2*2*2*2*2 = 64 times of the amount put in deposit at the end of first 6 years i.e. at the end of 42 years, the deposit will become
200 × 64 = 12800

questions.qtext:
The sum of all possible 4 digit numbers formed using the digits 4, 6, 6 and 7, with each digit is used exactly once is ___________.

Numerical answer type
questions.solution:
Since digit ‘6’ is coming twice in each of the numbers formed, we can say that
‘4’ comes in unit’s place 3 times
‘6’ comes in unit’s place 6 times
‘7’ comes in unit’s place 3 times leading to sum of unit digit of all possible numbers as
(3 × 4) + (6 × 6) + (3 × 7) = 69.
For digits in 10’s place, in hundred’s place as well as thousand’s place also, the sum of respective digit of all the possible numbers will be 69.
The sum of all possible numbers will be
(1 × 69) + (10 × 69) + (100 × 69) + (1000 × 69) = 1111 × 69 = 76659

If my sister was 4 years of age when my brother was born, then, what was the age of my father and mother respectively when my brother was born?
questions.solution: Clearly, my brother was born 3 years before I was born and 4 years after my sister was born. So, father’s age when brother was born = (28 + 4) years = 32 years; mother’s age when brother was born = (26 – 3) years = 23 years.

questions.qtext:
In this question, a group of numbers/symbols is coded using letter codes as per the codes given below and the conditions which follow. The correct combination of codes following the conditions is your answer. If none of the conditions follow, then codes for the respective Number/Symbol are to be followed directly as given in the table.

Conditions –

  1. If the first element is a symbol and the last a number, the codes for these two (the first and the last elements) are to be interchanged.
  2. If the first element is an odd number and the last an even number, the first and last elements are to be coded as ©
  3. If both second and third elements are perfect squares, the third element is to be coded as the code for the second element.

What will be the code for the following group?
7 4 9 @ $
questions.solution:
7 → A
4 → Z
9 → V
@ → N
$ → E

For the given group of symbols/numbers, conditions (i) and (ii) does not apply.
As second and third number is perfect square. Therefore, condition (iii) apply.
So, answer will be A Z Z N E.
